text:
jess: Heads up — planning a tethered micro-rollout for the `response-cache` change tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Low-risk plan: 0.2% -> 1% -> 5% over ~90m. cohorts = internal-beta + 3 small geo buckets. who can own smoke?

mike: I can own the first 0.2% smoke and immediate rollback if latency spikes.

anya: i'll take the 1% step and watch qps/99p. will have alert window open.

sam: pinging oncall to be reachable 10:00-12:00 UTC. i'm available for rollback actions.

jess: thanks. deploy will be performed by `deploy-bot` with manual go at each step. config snippet below — this is what i'll push to the rollout API:

```json
{
  "strategy": "tethered_ramp",
  "steps": [
    {"percent": 0.2, "duration_mins": 15},
    {"percent": 1, "duration_mins": 30},
    {"percent": 5, "duration_mins": 45}
  ],
  "cohorts": ["internal-beta","eu-small","us-west-small","ap-sg-small"],
  "rollback_on": ["latency_p99>500ms","error_rate>0.5%"]
}
```

ryan: nit: can we add a KV-cache warmup check? last time cold cache caused a spike at 0.5%.

jess: good call — will pre-warm prefixes for the cohorts and add a healthcheck that fails if kv_miss_rate > 5%.

mike: smoke checklist i'm running:
- hit internal-beta with 20 requests/sec for 5m
- verify p50/p95/p99 within baseline +10%
- check error traces for new opcodes
- confirm no increase in tail GC

anya: i'll run the automated canary-eval after the 1% bump (script: `scripts/canary_eval.sh`). will post results in thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout queued by jess for 2026-03-19T10:00:00Z. Manual approval required at each step.

sam: FYI I've pinned the rollback playbook here: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/rollbacks#tethered-rollout — step 2 is the fast-path if p99 > 500ms for 3 consecutive minutes.

jess: target SLA for this deploy: <300ms p99 increase and <0.2% error bump. if we exceed either, rollback immediately.

mike: ack. i'll be online at 09:45 UTC to prep logs and traces.

anya: ack, will post canary-eval output and graphs. if anything smells off i'll trigger rollback. :thumbsup:

ryan: quick Q — are we including the quantized model variant for ap-sg-small cohort? that affects KV usage.

jess: yes, ap-sg-small will use the `response-cache-quant` variant (lighter memory). i've added variant mapping to config.

deploy-bot: Approval step 1 ready — approver: mike. Use `/deploy approve 1797881122 step1` to continue.

mike: approved. `/deploy approve 1797881122 step1`

deploy-bot: Step 1 (0.2%) started at 2026-03-19T10:00:15Z. Monitoring channels opened: #telemetry, #oncall.

anya: Step1 pass — p99 stable, kv_miss_rate 1.2%, no errors. proceeding to manual go for step2?

mike: i'm good to continue. approving step2.

deploy-bot: Step 2 (1%) started at 2026-03-19T10:18:45Z.

jess: reminder: team lead should confirm rollback readiness before step3 — who will call it?

sam: i'll make the call at 10:45 if signals are green; otherwise i'll trigger the rollback.

anya: canary-eval script output: `pass` for latency, `warn` for a small uptick in tail traces — digging in. posting trace IDs in 2m.

ryan: found a hotspot in kv-populate loop under ap-sg-small. not critical but correlates with trace uptick.

mike: decision: continue to 5% but gate the ap-sg-small cohort until we confirm warmup effectiveness. keep rest of cohorts.

jess: ok — modifying rollout: hold ap-sg-small, proceed with others to 5%. updating config now.

deploy-bot: Step 3 (5%) started at 2026-03-19T11:10:00Z with cohort ap-sg-small excluded.

anya: final smoke — 5% stable for 10m, no error rate regression. will keep monitoring for next 30m.

sam: thanks all. if anything degrades please ping `#eng-oncall` and mention me.

jess: awesome work. post-mortem note: follow-up item to add auto pre-warm for new keys in rollout staging. I'll open PR after deploy.

mike: :rocket:

deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 2026-03-19T11:45:12Z — status: partial (ap-sg-small excluded). Logs archived to https://logs.internal/1797881122

jess: closing thread — will file the follow-up and link PR here. thanks everyone.
